title: Domain Pack: EC / Order Flow
summary: E-commerce domain-specific test considerations for order, payment, shipment, inventory, coupon, return, refund, cancellation. Common states: cart, order pending, payment authorized, paid, allocated, shipped, delivered, cancelled, returned, refunded. Risk hotspots: order/payment state divergence, inventory restoration errors, coupon/points restoration, shipped order cancellation, duplicate submit side effects, external service delayed/partial failure.
risks: Order state and payment state divergence
Inventory restored twice or not restored
